startDescription: The emergency broadcast on your phone didn't end with instructions; it ended with a wet, choking scream that cut to static just as the power grid blew, plunging your apartment into an oppressive, heavy darkness. Outside your third-story window, the familiar hum of the city has mutated into a chaotic symphony of screeching tires, distant explosions, and an underlying, rhythmic scuffling sound that makes the hairs on your arms stand up. A frantic, heavy pounding suddenly rattles your front door, accompanied by the panicked voice of your neighbor begging to be let in—but from the alleyway directly below your fire escape, you hear the unmistakable sound of breaking glass and a guttural, distinctly non-human howl.
initialPrompt: Using the tools available to you, design a choose-your-own adventure game based on the given scene descriptions.
